lore.bio:
Mirage is the kind of guy who likes to stand out. The youngest of four brothers, he perfected the art of fooling around to get attention. The one thing he took seriously was Holo-Pilot technology: introduced to the illusion-creating tech by his engineer mother, he poured over the mechanisms and learned all he could about them. Even when his brothers went MIA during the Outlands’ Civil War, Mirage and his mother continued to develop holo devices, and the work brought them closer.
While working as a bartender to make ends meet, Mirage heard amazing stories from his patrons about the Apex Games and the wealth and glory that came with victory. As good as both of those sounded, he knew he couldn’t risk leaving his mother childless – until she gave him a set of customized holo devices and told him to follow his dream. Mirage is now the life of the Apex Games, outwitting opponents and charming audiences across the Outlands, in front of cameras for the world - and his mother - to see.

For more information on Mirage's story, see Mirage (character).

passive.name: Now You See Me...
passive.description: Automatically cloak when using Respawn Beacons or healing consumable items, but this ability is now disabled if silenced by Revenant while reviving teammates or downed. The cloak is removed by damage, ability use, or dropping the heal action.

tactical.name: Psyche Out
tactical.description: Send out a holographic decoy to confuse the enemy. Press ⬆️ to control the decoy. The decoy has 30 HP, makes footstep sounds, and swaps weapons with you when you do, also properly holstering melee weapons.

ultimate.name: Life of the Party
ultimate.description: Mirage deploys a team of controllable decoys to distract enemies. Each decoy has 45 HP, lasts for 30 seconds, and only 3 decoys are deployed.

details: [Base] Fix -> Power Sword VFX no longer visible while cloaked
[Tac & Ult] Buff -> decoys now swap weapons when you do and also properly holster melee weapons
[Base] Fix -> Cloak while healing should no longer occasionally end early when exiting a Lifeline Halo
[Base] Fix -> Ult cloak should no longer end early when immediately reviving an ally
[Ultimate] Fix -> Fixed a crash that could occur when using Mirage’s Ult near Gravity Cannons
[Tactical] Fix -> Lifeline’s D.O.C. now cloaks properly to prevent revealing Mirage
[Passive] Buff -> Now You See Me…: now also cloaks when using a healing consumable item.
[Passive] Nerf -> Now You See Me…: cloak is removed by damage, ability use, or dropping the heal action.
[Passive] Adjust -> Now You See Me…: entering cloak now only takes 1s (was 1.5s).

[Perks] Buff -> Upgrades: Level 2 Boozle-Eye: Bamboozles now also scan the target who shot the clone, Renaissance Man: gain access to all other Classes’ world interactions: Assault Bins, Care Package scans, Survey Beacons, and Ring Consoles.
[Passive] Buff -> Life of the Party : health bars no longer show during Ultimate to give away the real Mirage
[Perks] Adjust -> Battpack : in addition to the extra battery per stack, this upgrade now also shows battery counts in Death Boxes
[Class] Buff -> Class changed from Skirmisher to Support.
[Passive] Adjust -> Encore: increased decoy duration but reduced number of decoys.
[Tactical] Nerf -> Psyche Out: reduced damage and radius.
[Now You See Me...] Buff -> Cloaked respawn is now disabled if silenced by Revenant.
[Decoys] Fix -> Decoys now make footstep sounds.
[Boogie Down skin] Fix -> Fixed an issue with the Boogie Down skin blocking vision while aiming down sights and releasing a decoy at the same time.
Psyche Out/ Life of the Party: Decoys now have 45 HP.
[Perks] Buff -> Psyche Out: Reverted cooldown back to 15 seconds from 25.

right.name: Perk Niv. 2 Droite
right.description: In addition to the extra battery per stack, this upgrade now also shows battery counts in Death Boxes and allows Bamboozles to scan the target who shot the clone.
